t: This is St. Andrew's Church in West Kensington, near Fulham. It was founded in 1873 and has been Grade Two listed since 2009. It's notable because some of its parishioners were responsible for establishing Fulham Football Club. Several architects are credited with its design: John Newman, Arthur Billing, and Ingress Bell, who worked for many years with Sir Aston Webb. Webb designed the principal facade of Buckingham Palace and the main building of the Victoria and Albert Museum.
